verses.gurmukhi: ੭ : ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਫੋਕਟ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 7 : bhaau bhagat to(n) binaa(n) fokaT hai

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਖ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: sahas siaanap lakh ka(n)m na aavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of skills make no avail.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan unamaan a(n)t na paavahee|

en.bdb: Myriads of knowledges, concentrations and inferences are unable to know the mysteries of Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਲਖ ਭਾਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧੵਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh saseear lakh bhaan ahinis dhayeaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of moons and suns adore Him day and night.
And millions of people remain imbued with humility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਗਰਬ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਲਜ ਲਜਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh garab gumaan laj lajaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions are worshipping the Lord according to their own religious traditions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦੀਨ ਈਮਾਨ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh dheen ieemaan taaRee laavahee|

en.bdb: Millions are worshipping the Lord according to their own religious traditions.
Only through loving devotion one can merge in the Lord, the absolute truth.
